purpose: Canonical Powerhouse problem taxonomy shared by portal, Problem Radar, capabilities, content, sales and outcome learning.
invariants: No problem may be presented as fact without evidence.
External signals alone remain hypotheses until validated.
Financial impact must be labelled OBSERVED, ESTIMATED or POTENTIAL.
Every material recommendation maps to an action or capability and an outcome metric.
Cross-customer learning may use only approved aggregated/anonymized patterns; tenant data remains isolated.
